ranked_lanes.paragraph: SMB-PR-MULTICAM-PLAY-1 (rank 3, READ unless marked). Multicam records are stored and kept valid (session multicam guard, SMB-PR-ROUTING-REPAIR-1) but nothing plays them: `pulse/src/multicam.rs:932` resolve_active_angle has callers only in pulse tests, and its own doc (`:929-931`) says program-monitor playback of the active angle is not wired. The monitor renders a multicam clip as a plain nest through `pulse/src/nest.rs:720` frame_layers_nested_on_grids (`harness-view/src/view/monitor.rs:574`), and audio plays through `NestedAudioSources` (`pulse/src/nest.rs:815`, used at `harness-view/src/view/audio_session.rs:97`), so the top angle shows and every angle's audio sums: a silent wrong output in video-edit steps 31 and 32. The lane adds a multicam-aware variant of both nest resolvers in pulse that takes `StudioMulticamRecords` and resolves the active angle (video and, with audio-follows-video, audio) per tick, makes the monitor, the export path and the mixdown pass the session's multicam entry, and exposes plan_multicam_create, toggle, switch with and without cut, audio follows video and flatten (`pulse/src/multicam.rs:470`, `:560`, `:697`, `:782`, `:1086`, subreader) as typed rows beside the monitor rows (`harness-core/src/action/commands/monitor.rs`). It moves video-edit steps 28-35 and 37. The audio half edits audio_session.rs, which SMB-SCORE-EFFECTS-6 owns now: land the video half first, then the one audio call site after that lane, or ask. The multicam grid view (step 30) is a GUI panel and stays out. Research: Premiere's 'Multi-Camera Audio Follows Video' monitor setting is documented only by forum reports in this pass (UNVERIFIED, D5). ranked_lanes.paragraph: SMB-PR-CONFORM-PEAKS-1 (rank 4, READ unless marked). Every mixed-rate project is refused today: `audio.bind_sound` refuses a file at another rate `audio_rate_mismatch` ('no resampler', `harness-view/src/view/commands/audio.rs:59`, `:90`), and `project_bind` lists such items in not_bound because conform (STU-VID-053, spec :24879) is not built (`harness-view/src/view/project.rs:30-35`, `:476-477`), though score holds a resampler with receipts (`score/src/resample.rs:29` ClipResampler, `:65` ResampleReceipt; `score/src/src_bounce.rs:22`) that no host calls. The waveform overview is an in-memory cache (`harness-view/src/view/timeline/audio.rs:230-343`, subreader) and project bin items have no peak or conform field (`folio/src/project_bin.rs:81-100`). The lane adds a conform job per audio item (resample to the sequence rate once, content-addressed, cached as a derived artifact named by the item's digest and the target rate), and a peak file job, both admitted through the existing job port with progress and cancel, records on the bin item for conform state and peak digest, and makes bind and bind_sound use the conformed source instead of refusing. It moves audio-post steps 7 and 8 and video-edit step 10, and unblocks every real project mixing 44.1 and 48 kHz. Open questions: where derived artifacts live (Handshake_Artifacts or the package; default: content-addressed in the package's derived area, UNVERIFIED that one exists), and the resampler quality setting (default: the score resampler's tested default). It must not edit audio_session.rs while SMB-SCORE-EFFECTS-6 is in flight; bind_sound's file is commands/audio.rs. ## Target

Backlog row SMB-MOTION-COMMANDS-1 landed (0a733db8: 2b54bbc8, 912cb86f) and left its declared limits (`harness-core/src/motion_commands.rs:28-31`): no solid, adjustment, text or footage kind (`:993-994`, `layer_kind_unsupported`), no keyframe selection, copy or paste, no expression store. This lane closes the layer-kind and keyframe part that panels and scripts need first. Motion-comp scenario steps 16 (solid), 17 (Gradient Ramp on the solid), 28 (Easy Ease), 44 (adjustment layer with Levels and Tint) become callable; step 19 (text) is proven through rows that exist. All file:line at 0a733db8, paths under `handshake-studio-assets/crates/hsk-studio-`.

Clauses (spec module `14-studio-creative-suite.md`, v02.229): STU-MOT-005 :25959 (ten layer kinds: `solid` :25969, `adjustment` :25975), STU-MOT-006 :25980, STU-CMP-015 :29538 (adjustment effects apply to the composite beneath; masks scope where, opacity scales how much, in/out scope when; adjustment layers nest), STU-MOT-034 :27635, STU-MOT-037 :27680, STU-MOT-038 :27695 (select-all three scopes :27706, deselect :27708, shift selected 1 or 10 frames :27710, copy, paste and REVERSE paste :27712, set interpolation per selection :27713), STU-MOT-039 :27718, STU-MOT-130 :28326, STU-FX-130 :13163.

1. **Red first, compiling.** New `harness/tests/motion_commands_2.rs` (feature `media`, like `harness/tests/motion_commands.rs:617`), parameters as JSON values through `Run::motion_command` (`harness-core/src/harness.rs:1599`), so the red commit compiles and every new row refuses (`row` lookup `motion_commands.rs:62-67` returns none until the rows exist). New `composite/tests/composition_adjustment_effects.rs` with records written as JSON. Prove red by running.

2. **Folio.**
   - `StudioMotionRecords` (`folio/src/motion_records.rs:656-676`) gains `solid_layers: Vec<StudioSolidLayer>`, `#[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Vec::is_empty")]` as its siblings (`:659-675`), added to `new` (`:678-689`), so existing record sets stay byte-identical. `StudioSolidLayer {layer_id, width, height, colour}`: no such type exists (`git grep 'StudioSolidLayer'` empty, READ). Validation beside the shape-layer checks: the layer is in a composition and its document layer is an empty raster layer (the shape precedent, `harness-core/src/motion_commands.rs:1023-1027`), one record per layer, not also a shape or text-animator layer (`procedural_layer_twice`, composite `temporal/motion_records.rs:388-390`), width and height 1..=30000 (the STU-MOT-122 resize bound, :28283-28284; the solid size bound is not stated by STU-MOT-005, so this is a Studio reading), finite colour components 0..=1. Colour type: the one shape fills use (NOT_INSPECTED name; read `StudioShapeItem` fill before choosing).
   - Adjustment kind: Folio's document validator accepts `kind = "adjustment"` only with a `PrimitiveReference` to `ADJUSTMENT_SCHEMA` (`folio/src/lib.rs:931-942`), and the raster records then require a pigment adjustment record for it (`folio/src/raster.rs:1812-1828`). An After Effects adjustment layer has no pigment adjustment of its own. Accept `kind = "adjustment"` with `Payload::Group` as the composition adjustment layer of STU-CMP-015 (ValueType::Image like the pigment one). The raster checks test the `PrimitiveReference` payload (`raster.rs:1762-1764`, `:1819-1820`), so they do not demand a record for it; prove that with a test. See open question 1 for the alternative.

3. **Composite.**
   - Solid: `procedural_layers` (`composite/src/temporal/motion_records.rs:372-399`) gains `ProceduralLayer::Solid`, lowered by building a one-rectangle shape group with a solid fill and calling the same `shape_layer_content` (`:420`), so a solid draws through the shape path, not a second rasteriser. Test: a solid equals byte for byte the equivalent rectangle shape layer.
   - Adjustment effects (STU-CMP-015): `CompositionTemporalSource` maps document layers at `temporal/composition.rs:930-1001`; add an arm for kind `adjustment` with `Payload::Group` BEFORE the `(None, Payload::Group) => Content::None` arm (`:975`) and before the static arm (`:952-954`, whose pattern includes `Payload::Group`). Without effects it is `Content::None` (renders nothing, as STU-CMP-015 'no content of its own'). `read_effects` (`temporal/composition/effects.rs:240-252`) refuses the stack for `Content::None | Content::Adjustment(_)`; keep that refusal for nulls and pigment adjustment layers, lift it for this kind. New `SceneContent` variant (`composite/src/composition.rs:114-168`, `#[non_exhaustive]`), handled in the root loop beside `SceneContent::Adjustment` (`composition.rs:959-997`): render everything beneath the layer into one straight RGBA f32 surface B with the backend the scene already uses (the nested-content render `content_surface` used by `effected_surface`, `composition/effect_stack.rs:846-875`), run the entries over B in stack order with the existing CPU kernels to E, and write L = B + k * (E - B) with k = layer opacity * mask coverage (masks fold as layer-space coverage, `effects.rs:16-21`). L replaces the layers beneath in the root plan as one tile, as `SceneContent::Effected` places its surface (`composition.rs:1134-1146`). Nested adjustment layers then compose by construction (the lower result is part of B). Charge B and E with `charges.surface` as `effect_stack.rs:873-878` does.
   - Typed refusals, each with a test: blend mode other than normal `composition_adjustment_blend` (open question 2); 3D adjustment layer (`COMPOSITION_3D_CONTENT`, as `temporal/composition.rs:1080-1081`); a track matte on it (`ADJUSTMENT_MATTE`, as `composition.rs:960-964`); the document-graph path (already refuses any stack, `temporal/composition.rs:1255`); inside a collapsed precomposition; a pigment adjustment layer (PrimitiveReference) with a stack stays `COMPOSITION_EFFECT_CONTENT`.
   - Reader sweep (V4-06) for a group-payload adjustment layer: every reader that tests kind `adjustment` - `composite/src/lower_extensions.rs:146-150`, `folio/src/raster.rs:1677`, `:1700`, `:1762`, `:1819`, `harness-core/src/harness.rs:124`, `harness-view/src/view/info.rs:311`, `harness-view/src/view/render.rs:582` - and the static document render of a raster document holding one (outside a composition it must refuse typed, never draw as an empty group without a word). List each site fixed or not applicable with a reason.

4. **Commands (harness-core `motion_commands.rs`, rows in `action/commands/motion.rs:37-90`).**
   - `composition.add_layer` (`layer_add`, `:980-1061`): kind `solid` (empty raster document layer through `create_layer` `:276-297`, plus the `StudioSolidLayer`; width and height default to the composition's, `colour` required) and kind `adjustment` (document layer kind `adjustment`, payload group: `create_layer` builds only `group` or `raster` today, `:281-288`, so give it the kind). New row `composition.set_solid` (colour, width, height; one named step). `layer_duplicate` (`:1085-1105`) copies a solid's record with the layer, and an adjustment layer duplicates like a group. `remove_layer_records` (`:1063`) drops the solid record.
   - `footage` and `guide` stay `layer_kind_unsupported` (footage is the next motion lane). Text: no `text` kind; the typed path is `vector.place_text_with_font` (`harness-core/src/action/commands/vector.rs:34`, `Viewer::place_text_with_font` `harness-view/src/view/text.rs:698`) then `composition.add_layer kind=existing` (`motion_commands.rs:989-992`). Add a `media` test that renders the composition through `session_render_queue_jobs` and finds the text: today no test does (UNVERIFIED that it renders). If it refuses, report the code and stop there for text.
   - Keyframe selection and clipboard: transient state in `Run`, beside `web: web_commands::WebHost` (`harness-core/src/harness.rs:459`, built at `:256`; struct `:426`): selected keys as `(layer_id, property address, tick)` and one clipboard. Not a document edit, no history step, not saved. A selected key that no longer exists after an edit, undo or redo is dropped when read and counted. Rows: `keyframe.select` (scope `property|layer|composition`, mode `replace|add|remove`, optional `times`), `keyframe.deselect_all`, `keyframe.selection` (read), `keyframe.copy` (selection, or explicit `layer_id`, `property`, `times`), `keyframe.paste` (target `layer_id`, optional `property`, `time`, `reverse`), `keyframe.shift_selected` (`frames`, any non-zero integer in composition frames; the 1 and 10 steps are the GUI's), `keyframe.ease` (`side both|in|out`) and `keyframe.toggle_hold` over the selection. scopes.target:
## Target

Delivery has two engine halves and no product path joining them. Sequence export takes one of six reel preset ids (`harness-view/src/view/timeline_export.rs:616` `preset_recipe`, `timeline/export_media.rs:505` `export_sequence`), while `StudioExportRecipe` (`reel/src/export_recipe.rs:273`, `resolve` `:547`, `job_from_recipe` `:739`, shipped presets as the same record `reel/src/presets.rs:110`) has no caller in harness-view, harness-core or harness (git grep, READ). The composition render queue builds reel jobs (`harness-view/src/view/timeline_export/render_queue.rs:361` `session_render_queue_jobs`) that only harness tests run (`harness/tests/motion_commands.rs:700`, `motion_records_session.rs:193`; `harness-view/src/view/job_admission.rs:38-40` says so). Output formats are MOV VC-3 and MOV/MP4 AV1 only (`folio/src/motion_records.rs:542`); `rgb_alpha` is refused (`render_queue.rs:203`) and post-render actions too (`:206`). This lane gives both one typed, headless, admitted queue (STU-VID-064 :25560, STU-MOT-124 :28302-28308, STU-MOT-125 :28310), user recipes, and a PNG image sequence with alpha. All file:line at 0a733db8, paths under `handshake-studio-assets/crates/hsk-studio-`.

Clauses: STU-IO-101 :21135, STU-IO-110 :21191, STU-IO-142 :21337, STU-IO-163 :21420, STU-IO-164 :21422, STU-IO-166 :21426, STU-VID-060 :24889, STU-VID-061 :24894, STU-VID-063 :25554, STU-VID-064 :25560, STU-MOT-120 :28245, STU-MOT-121 :28251, STU-MOT-122 :28279 (channels RGB, alpha, RGB+alpha; color premultiplied or straight; starting_number and use_comp_frame_number), STU-MOT-122a :28292, STU-MOT-124 :28302, STU-MOT-125 :28310.

1. **Red first, compiling.** New `harness/tests/delivery_queue.rs` (feature `media`) through the drive rows and `Viewer` methods, with records as JSON, every row refusing until built. Prove red by running.

2. **One queue (harness-view, new egui-free `src/view/delivery.rs`).** Items are either `sequence` (sequence id, recipe id, span, output path) or `composition` (render queue item id from the motion records, `StudioMotionRecords.render_queue`). One `Viewer::delivery_run` builds every item's jobs, admits them through `AdmittedExportQueue` (`job_admission.rs:226`, built by `admitted_export_queue` `timeline_export.rs:608`), runs them on one worker like `export_sequence_inner` (`export_media.rs:514-537`) and returns one receipt per item and module: recipe identity, source span, output artifact or artifacts, outcome, partial output named when canceled (STU-MOT-125 :28313-28314). Cancel one item without cancelling the rest (STU-VID-064 'one queue with per-item receipts'); test it. Settlement keeps `completed_stale` (`job_admission.rs:17-20`).
   - Sequence items resolve a `StudioExportRecipe` (shipped preset through `ExportPreset::studio_recipe`, or a user recipe) through `job_from_recipe`; the six-identifier writer binding (`export_recipe.rs:24-28`, `:83-100`) stays: any other parameter refuses `export_parameter_not_consumed` before the first frame. `export_sequence` (`export_media.rs:505`) keeps working with `preset_id` and becomes a thin call into the same path (one implementation, a pinned byte test against today's output).
   - Composition items need a product `ScenePixels` over the open document's tiles. Only test impls and the monitor's media `Frames` exist (`harness-view/src/view/monitor.rs:259`); wrap the static renderer's tile source (`harness-view/src/view/render.rs:622` `TileInfoSource for TileTable`, `:648` tile planes by `SourceKey`) keyed by the composition adapter's tile id `"{layer_id}/{object_key}"` (`composite/src/temporal/composition.rs:984`). Glyphs from `view::text::animated_glyphs` (`harness-view/src/view/text.rs:487`), audio layers from the bound sound port (`export_media.rs:447-468`). NOT_INSPECTED: whether TileTable can be borrowed for the worker's lifetime; if not, copy the planes the items name, charged.

3. **User recipes (STU-VID-063 'a user recipe is the same record as a shipped one').** A document entry `export_recipes` holding `StudioExportRecipe::to_json` texts (`export_recipe.rs:594`) keyed by `recipe_id`; reel has no JSON parser by design (`export_recipe.rs:36`), so the host parses into `set_parameter` calls (`:468`), which check every value (unknown ids, credentials, bounds). Add the token to `session/src/source.rs:176` `DOCUMENT_ENTRY_TOKENS`, validated by its producer on set and read like `raster_records`. Rows: `export.recipe_save` (from a preset or recipe id plus parameter edits, new id), `export.recipe_delete`, `export.recipes` (read: shipped and user, with does_video, does_audio). STU-IO-166 puts recipes in SurrealDB tables; this asset has none (open question 1).

4. **PNG image sequence with alpha (STU-MOT-122, motion step 84).** `StudioOutputFormat` (`folio/src/motion_records.rs:542`) gains `PngSequence` (a `settings_enum!` member; documents that do not use it stay byte-identical, an older reader refuses one that does). In `module_output` (`render_queue.rs:194-252`) a PNG module is not a reel job: frames from the shared render (`SharedFrames`, `timeline_export/composition.rs:345`) through `OutputPost::apply_rgba` (`:521`, written for exactly this) and `hsk_studio_interop_raster::png::encode_png` (`interop-raster/src/png.rs:240`; harness-view already depends on interop-raster under `viewer`, `harness-view/Cargo.toml:14`, `:15`, `:45`). `channels` rgb, alpha or rgb_alpha, `color` straight or premultiplied, depth 8 or 16, file names from `starting_number` and `use_comp_frame_number` (`motion_records.rs:598-599`, bound checked at `:1054`) with a declared zero-padded width. Each file written no-clobber like the export publish path (`reel/src/export.rs`, SMB-PR-EXPORT-RECIPE-1 hard-link publish) and named in the receipt; a cancel names the frames written. `rgb_alpha` on MOV stays refused `output_alpha_codec`: no reel encoder carries alpha (ProRes is decode-only, `reel/src/prores/SOURCE_PROVENANCE.json`).

5. **Render queue commands (STU-MOT-125).** The queue records are typed (`harness-core/src/action/commands/motion.rs:45-50`: queue_add, queue_remove, queue_set_settings, queue_add_module, queue_set_module, queue_remove_module). Add `composition.queue_reorder` and `composition.queue_duplicate` beside them in `harness-core/src/motion_commands.rs` (render_queue edits `:945-978`), and `composition.queue_apply_template` taking a stored user recipe or a named render-settings and output-module template (open question 3). Post-render actions stay refused (`render_queue.rs:206`).

6. **Typed surface and process.** RUN_COMMANDS or typed Viewer rows in `harness-core/src/action/commands/export.rs` (today `export.set_settings`, `export.run` for documents, `:16-26`): `delivery.add`, `delivery.remove`, `delivery.list`, `delivery.run`, `delivery.cancel`, `delivery.receipts`, plus the recipe rows. A CLI verb `deliver PACKAGE --item ...` beside `export-sequence` (`harness/src/cli.rs:577-612`, `execute_export_sequence` `:1282`), headless (STU-IO-164). The queue itself is per-Viewer state, not saved (open question 2).

open_questions.question: STU-IO-166 stores recipes in SurrealDB tables; the asset has no store. Where do user recipes live?
open_questions.default: A document entry export_recipes in the package, recorded as an SD item, because a recipe must travel with the project in the asset-local build and STU-IO-110 makes recipes portable artifacts; a host store can import them later.

open_questions.question: Is the delivery queue saved with the document (like the AE render queue records) or per session?
open_questions.default: Per Viewer, not saved: composition items already persist as StudioRenderQueueItem; sequence items are cheap to re-add; saving needs a new record.

open_questions.question: What is a render-settings or output-module template (STU-MOT-125) in records?
open_questions.default: An output-module template is a user StudioExportRecipe with does_video and the module's fields mapped; render-settings templates are next slice. Refuse queue_apply_template for render settings with a typed code.

open_questions.question: PNG sequence frame-number padding width is not stated by STU-MOT-122.
open_questions.default: Seven digits, because starting_number's hard_max is 9999999 (:28282), so every number fits and names sort.

open_questions.question: Does export_sequence keep its preset_id parameter?
open_questions.default: Yes, as a recipe id alias resolved through ExportPreset::studio_recipe, so the CLI and existing tests keep working.

notes: Trees: rank 1 smb-folio-angle-unbounded-1, rank 2 smb-r53-followups-1, rank 3 smb-pr-edit-footprint-1, rank 4 smb-pr-sequence-session-1. All four READ clean with tips that are ancestors of 0a733db8, and their targets hold every hsk crate these lanes name. If the raster, vector or design planner takes one, the fallbacks are named in each entry. Target sizes were not measured (du over these targets did not finish within the tool timeout).

Not ranked, with reasons (READ): BWF with timecode has no spec clause (backlog spec_questions) and no bext writer exists; stems for a bus feeding a bus are refused typed stem_not_top_level (audio_session.rs:459-461) while a parent stem already includes its nested submixes (:243-256), so it is a refusal, not wrong output, and audio_session.rs is SMB-SCORE-EFFECTS-6's file now. Expressions need a Folio store, an evaluator wire and the G1 catalogue decision; they are next_slices of rank 1. The composition effect catalogue (20 kinds) is wide but ranks below layer kinds that every title needs.
Finding (READ, subreader): audio stems are replaced on disk before the sum check runs (audio_session.rs:536-546 before :547); a failed check leaves new stems and only flags sums_to_print false.
Finding (READ, subreader): every typed audio, mixer, waveform and spectral row is recordable false (harness-core action/commands.rs:158-160), so action replay (audio-post step 96) stays blocked.

Finding (READ): the composition render queue passes RenderInputs::default() (harness-view timeline_export/render_queue.rs:402-413), so any composition holding a pigment adjustment or fill layer refuses at render (temporal/composition.rs:966-970 REFUSE_ADJUSTMENT_RECORD). This shaped rank 1's choice not to use fill layers for solids.

Finding (READ, subreader): every transition kind still plays as a weighted dissolve (pulse transition.rs:137, playback.rs:774). This is silent wrong output outside these four lanes; it is video-edit gap 8.

Method limits: nothing was built, run or tested. Every line marked reader=subreader was read through git at 0a733db8 by a delegated read-only reader in this pass and not re-read by the planner. The spec line numbers are from 14-studio-creative-suite.md of v02.229, read by the planner. Web research was three standard searches through summaries, no page fetched; vendor parity is UNVERIFIED (D5) throughout.
